name: portal-forcer-nether-floor-survival
notes: Natural nether floor near (0,0), survival-style edits only: liquids, loose blocks and every air cell of y=1..14 filled with netherrack (placing blocks), then everything above y=4 mined out (netherrack only, bedrock untouched). The floor surface is now flat at y=4: natural bedrock where the floor reaches y=4, netherrack elsewhere. An item enters an overworld portal at y=5; the exit's frame bottom row lands on y=4. Asserts the portal, the four obsidian frame-bottom cells, and (masked compare against a copy) that at least one natural bedrock block of the floor changed.

execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:lava
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:gravel
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:soul_sand
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:soul_soil
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:magma_block
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:nether_quartz_ore
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:nether_gold_ore
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -9 1 -9 9 14 9 minecraft:netherrack replace minecraft:air
execute in minecraft:the_nether run fill -8 5 -8 8 12 8 minecraft:air replace minecraft:netherrack

fill 0 5 0 1 7 0 minecraft:nether_portal[axis=x]

summon minecraft:item 0.5 5.3 0.5 {Item:{id:"minecraft:stone",count:1},NoGravity:1b,PickupDelay:32767}
